source.title: Senior Delegate Announcement - Africa, Asia South and Asia West (June 2024)
source.content:
We are happy to announce we have two new Senior Delegates:

1. Maverick Pearson - Africa 
2. Sachin Arvind - Asia South and Asia West


They were selected by the WCA Board by voting among them, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2022.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf) about Senior Delegates.


We extend our support and best wishes to Maverick and Sachin in fulfilling their new responsibilities. Their terms as Senior Delegate started 23 June, 2024.


Maverick was among two applicants we had for the Senior Delegate (Africa) role and both candidacy documents can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1leIjoYzU_kmM6pO7MxAa9vabmbUHhovq).


Other than Maverick, the following applicant for Africa was:

* Samuel Baird


Sachin was among two applicants we had for the Senior Delegate (Asia South and Asia West) role and both candidacy documents can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RbRf2t-I_JYryqIp1ew3lBGKH7TgQ1Xs) if you are interested in viewing them.


Other than Sachin, the following applicant for Asia South and Asia West was:

* Abdullah Gulab

translation.title: 非洲、南亚及西亚高级代表任命公告（2024 年 6 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布两位新任高级代表：

1. Maverick Pearson——非洲。
2. Sachin Arvind——南亚及西亚。

WCA 董事会依照高级代表[动议](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2022.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf)第 4 节的规定，通过内部投票选定了他们。

我们支持 Maverick 和 Sachin，并祝愿他们顺利履行新的职责。两人的高级代表任期自 2024 年 6 月 23 日开始。

非洲高级代表一职共有两人申请，Maverick 是其中之一。两人的申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1leIjoYzU_kmM6pO7MxAa9vabmbUHhovq)查看。

另一位非洲高级代表申请者是：

* Samuel Baird

南亚及西亚高级代表一职同样有两人申请，Sachin 是其中之一。有兴趣了解的成员可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RbRf2t-I_JYryqIp1ew3lBGKH7TgQ1Xs)查看两人的申请材料。

另一位南亚及西亚高级代表申请者是：

* Abdullah Gulab
